# adds_group_member (Resource)

Adds a single member to an Active Directory group.

This resource is **non-authoritative**: it manages one membership and ignores every other member of the group. Use one resource per membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_group" "server_admins" {
  name  = "Server Admins"
  path  = "Contoso/Groups"
  scope = "DomainLocal"
}

resource "adds_group" "windows_admins" {
  name  = "Windows Admins"
  path  = "Contoso/Groups"
  scope = "Global"
}

# Nest one managed group inside another.
resource "adds_group_member" "windows_admins_in_server_admins" {
  group  = adds_group.server_admins.id
  member = adds_group.windows_admins.id
}

# Members that are not managed by Terraform are referenced by name.
resource "adds_group_member" "svc_backup" {
  group  = adds_group.server_admins.id
  member = "svc-backup"
}

# One resource per membership composes with for_each.
resource "adds_group_member" "operators" {
  for_each = toset(["alice", "bob", "carol"])

  group  = adds_group.windows_admins.id
  member = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Group to add the member to. Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`.
- `member` (String) Member to add. Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`. May be a user, group, computer or service account.

### Read-Only

- `group_dn` (String) Distinguished name of the group.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier, formed as `<group objectGUID>/<member objectGUID>`.
- `member_class` (String) Object class of the member, for example `user`, `group` or `computer`.
- `member_dn` (String) Distinguished name of the member.
- `member_sid` (String) Security identifier of the member.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Memberships are imported as "<group>/<member>", where each side accepts a
# distinguished name, objectGUID, SID or sAMAccountName.
terraform import adds_group_member.svc_backup "SERVER-ADMINS/svc-backup"
```
